`class PopTransition`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Transition`](/reference/ui/transition/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.transition` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [PopTransition.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/transition/PopTransition.java)

Transition that grows a UI from 75 % of its size when it opens and shrinks it back when it closes, in 130 ms, around its anchor.

![A popup grows into view on a dark card, stays open, then shrinks away when Escape closes it](/captures/catalog-transitions-poptransition.webp)

## Description

It is the transition of a popup.
